note: update_build_evpn_rfc7432_test.go::TestRFC7432PerESRouteDistributesESILabel: a per-ES A-D route with the ESI Label community (flags 0, All-Active) and an RT builds an UPDATE carrying both; without the ESI Label community it is refused with ErrEVPNOrigination while the RT is present, so the RT rule cannot trip first
